title: Flood shield supports.
officialText:
In areas of special flood hazard or shaded X-Zones, permanent attachments to building
façades necessary for the support and attachment of temporary, removable dry floodproofing barriers or shields may be
constructed to project beyond the street line for a distance of not more than 6 inches (152 mm).
